name: Advanced tool
description: The companion service this deployment is connected to, for the whole guild.
long_description:
Opens the companion service your operator connected to this deployment, at guild level, for the things a guild runs across all of its initiatives.

It signs you in on the way through, so there is no second account to keep. The same service is available inside a single initiative from that initiative's own menu; this adds the guild-wide view of it.

Guild admins only. Removing the app takes the entry away and changes nothing in the service itself.
